title: Buttercup Trail
description: Follow a gentle-looking buttercup trail through flower fields, rolling hills and a narrow path to a quiet pond. Extreme edition: tenfold machinery, spike-lined catches and compressed timing.

signs.text:
The gentle meadow
Pass while the thorn head is folded.

The quiet pond
Pass while the thorn head is folded.

rooms.name: The gentle meadow
rooms.lesson: Hop the low countryside fences. Pass while the thorn head is folded.

rooms.name: The buttercup field
rooms.lesson: The stones weave between flower beds. Pass while the thorn head is folded.

rooms.name: The rolling hills
rooms.lesson: Follow the ridge above the buttercups. Pass while the thorn head is folded.

rooms.name: The narrow flower trail
rooms.lesson: Keep your jumps inside the flower-lined passage. Pass while the thorn head is folded.

rooms.name: The quiet pond
rooms.lesson: Land on the quiet stones between the lily pools. Pass while the thorn head is folded.
